_comment: Security type of every SEC-registered offering (424B prospectus) the hub lists from the filing-fee exhibits: the fee exhibit gives only the total, so the type is read from the prospectus cover. items keyed by accession: type = debt (notes) | common (common stock offering) | preferred (mandatory convertible preferred, offered as depositary shares) | atm_program (an at-the-market program: the amount is a ceiling for future sales, not proceeds); title = the cover line(s); quote = the cover sentence the type rests on; method = cover-read (a person or the automated reader read the cover) | cover-regex (scripts/hyperscalers/classify-offerings.mjs, which runs on the automated job for new 424B filings). An accession absent here shows "type pending" on the page.
